title: Jameson Blake, Brent Manalo, Kolette Madelo make theater debut with ‘The Art of Breaking Up’
summary: Several Kapamilya artists made their theater debut with “The Art of Breaking Up” a play based on George de Jesus III’s award winning piece “Kung Paano Maghiwalay.”
